title: Generative Model Utils
summary: A personal utility library for synthetic tabular data generation, bundling preprocessing, postprocessing, statistical similarity, and ML utility assessment tools alongside a custom data transformer for generative models. Its gmm_data_transformer.py imports RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers to preprocess tabular data before synthesis.
needs: Cannot confirm call sites of these transformers beyond the import line; usage in actual synthesis pipeline not shown in evidence.
